data.desc: Capital Clean Energy Carriers Corp. (NASDAQ: CCEC), an international shipping company, is a leading platform of gas carriage solutions with a focus on energy transition. CCEC's in-the-water fleet comprises 21 high-specification vessels, including 15 latest-generation LNG/Cs, one legacy Neo-Panamax container vessel, three HMG/Cs and two MG/Cs. In addition, CCEC's under-construction fleet includes six additional latest-generation LNG/Cs, four MG/Cs, one HMG/C and one LNGB/V to be delivered between the first quarter of 2027 and the first quarter of 2029.
